description:
CONTEXT — PREREQUISITE: flm-40e.3 (Item 1b) must be complete. After Items 1a/1b, ~F templates produce VNode IR. The renderer must fully interpret those VNodes. FILE TO MODIFY: lib/filament/renderer.ex CURRENT STATE — render_vnode/2 arms (read file for exact code): def render_vnode({:text, content}, _context), do: content def render_vnode({:element, _tag, _attrs, children}, context) do Enum.map(children, &render_vnode(&1, context)) # BUG: no HTML wrapping, attrs dropped end def render_vnode({:component, mod, props, key}, context) do parent_fiber = %Fiber{id: context.fiber_id, component: context.fiber_id} child_id = Fiber.child_id(parent_fiber, mod, if(key, do: {:key, key}, else: {:index, 0})) child_context = %{context | fiber_id: child_id} render(mod, props, child_context) # BUG: child fiber not registered in new_fibers end def render_vnode({:keyed_list, items}, context) do Enum.map(items, fn {_key, vnode} -> render_vnode(vnode, context) end) # BUG: ignores keys end ALL THREE ARMS NEED FIXING. TARGET: :element arm Produce actual HTML iodata. Must handle: - Open tag with attributes:
- Attribute encoding: HTML-escape attribute values - Void elements (no closing tag): br, hr, input, img, meta, link, area, base, col, embed, param, source, track, wbr - Closing tag:
- Children: render each child recursively, concatenate - Event attributes (on_click, on_submit, on_change, etc.): transform to phx-click, phx-submit, phx-change etc. Event attribute transformation: if an attr key is :on_click, :on_submit, :on_change etc., call Filament.Hooks.register_event_handler/1 with the handler fn, get back a wire ref string, and emit phx-click={wire_ref} in the HTML. The mapping is: :on_VERB -> "phx-VERB". Read lib/filament/hooks.ex for the current register_event_handler/1 signature. TARGET: :component arm Goal: look up existing fiber for hook state continuity, create child RenderContext, call render/3, and register child fiber + all its descendants in the PARENT context's new_fibers map. Algorithm: 1. Compute child_id using Fiber.child_id/3 (lib/filament/fiber.ex -- read for exact API) parent_fiber: look up context.fiber_id in context.fiber_tree to get the Fiber struct mod: the component module discriminator: {:key, key} if key given, {:index, 0} otherwise 2. Look up existing fiber: Map.get(context.fiber_tree, child_id) 3. Build child RenderContext: fiber_id: child_id fiber_tree: context.fiber_tree (pass full tree for grandchild lookups) owner_pid: context.owner_pid new_fibers: %{} (fresh accumulator for this child's descendants) pending_effects: [] observable_stubs, subscribe_enabled: pass through from parent context hook_slots from existing fiber if found (state continuity) 4. Call render/3 -> {rendered, new_hook_slots, child_pending_effects, grandchild_fibers, new_event_handlers} 5. Build/update child Fiber struct with new_hook_slots, new_event_handlers, status :stable or :mounting 6. Update the PARENT context's new_fibers via Process.get/put(:filament_render_context): - Add {child_id => child_fiber} - Merge grandchild_fibers into parent's new_fibers 7. Bubble child_pending_effects into parent context's pending_effects (also via Process.get/put) 8. Return rendered (the Phoenix.LiveView.Rendered from the child) IMPORTANT: render_vnode is called during render/3 while the render context is live in the process dictionary. Update context fields using Process.get(:filament_render_context) and Process.put(:filament_render_context, updated_ctx). This pattern is already used by register_event_handler in hooks.ex. Read lib/filament/render_context.ex for exact struct fields. Read lib/filament/fiber.ex for exact Fiber struct fields and Fiber.child_id/3 API. TARGET: :keyed_list arm Key-based matching against existing fiber tree: 1. For each {key, vnode} in items where vnode is {:component, mod, props, key}: Compute child_id = Fiber.child_id(parent_fiber, mod, {:key, key}) Render using same logic as :component arm 2. After all items: compare rendered child_ids against children recorded in the parent fiber Any child_id in the old set but not in the new set -> mark that fiber as :unmounting (update its status in context.fiber_tree via Process.put) TESTING Run: mix test All existing tests must pass. Write tests in test/filament/renderer_test.exs (create if needed): 1. render_vnode({:text, "hello"}, ctx) returns "hello" 2. render_vnode({:element, :div, [class: "x"], [{:text, "hi"}]}, ctx) returns iodata containing "
hi
" 3. render_vnode({:element, :br, [], []}, ctx) returns "
" (void element, no closing tag) 4. render_vnode({:component, SomeComponent, %{foo: "bar"}, nil}, ctx) registers the child fiber in new_fibers 5. Rendering a component twice with the same key preserves hook_slots from the first render 6. render_vnode({:keyed_list, [{1, {:component, Item, %{}, 1}}, {2, ...}]}, ctx) registers both child fibers
title: Item 2: Complete render_vnode/2 — element HTML, component fiber registration, keyed reconciliation
